coord_system.axes_gltf: +X forward, +Y up (ground Y=0), +Z car right (-Z driver/left)
coord_system.principal_point: When pose.principalPoint is present it is the normalized original image principal point [cx/width, cy/height]; otherwise the optical axis crosses the image center.
coord_system.viewer_formula: d = radius * tan(15 deg) / tan(fov/2); eye = center + d * (sin(phi)*cos(theta), cos(phi), sin(phi)*sin(theta))

calibration_proxy.mesh: 2025_chevrolet_corvette_zr1.glb aligned to V2 WB=2.723m, mid-WB X=0, ground Y=0
calibration_proxy.note: The 2025 reference mesh initialized the exterior poses. Frames with photo_calibration use refinements from the Chevrolet images. Initial proxy metrics describe the old initialization only.
